items.title: No usable effect estimate for a nurse-led regional clinic
items.whyItMatters: The recorded search returned nothing; a cost-utility model would rest on borrowed estimates from different services.
items.opportunity: Measure effects locally with a concurrent comparison before modelling.

items.title: What the clinic delivers is unknown
items.whyItMatters: Reach and fidelity are not measured and the model changed twice.
items.opportunity: Measure reach, fidelity and adoption prospectively with a RE-AIM structure.

items.title: No utilities or patient-level costs
items.whyItMatters: A cost per QALY needs both.
items.opportunity: Collect the licensed utility questionnaire at the first visit and at three months, and cost clinic time by activity.

items.title: Patients who never reach the clinic
items.whyItMatters: Rural patients, people without a phone and people with limited English may be missed.
items.opportunity: Report reach by distance, language and deprivation.

errorsFound: A cost per QALY built now would present borrowed effect estimates as local evidence.
reevaluation: The gaps favour an implementation study that measures delivery, collects costs and utilities and compares readmissions with the hospitals without a clinic, so that an economic evaluation becomes possible later.
summary: Four gaps; the missing effect estimate, delivery and utility data are high severity.
